label: TP
reason: The code directly passes user-supplied input through Base64 encode/decode transformations without any sanitization or escaping. The resulting string 'bar' is passed to response.getWriter().format(), which uses printf-style formatting where % characters in the user input can trigger format string vulnerabilities (indicated by CodeQL rule java/tainted-format-string). While Base64 decoding does not inherently introduce XSS vectors, the lack of validation against special characters combined with the format string usage creates a genuine risk path.
